name: Semantic Isomorphism (Energy Cohesion) with Prose Bounds
description: Replaces graph/tree connectivity terms with a functional set-theoretic definition of "energy-cohesive" subsets (where every proper subset shares an interaction with its complement). Combined with exact narrative bounds (S07), this masks both the Steiner tree objective and the tree structure, forcing models to reason from first principles about what the subset condition implies.
